description: Labelled adversarial + realistic risk-scanner corpus (roadmap P1.1). 84 product ideas annotated with ground-truth risk flags (all 7 booleans) and applicable regulatory regimes (coppa, gdpr, hipaa, pci-dss, ccpa, ferpa, soc2, sox, dora, eu-ai-act), including explicit negation controls and benign offline tools.

cases.idea: Kids aged 8-12 build clubs, chat with friends, and send pocket-money gifts via Stripe. Parents approve with email.
SaaS for EU clinics scheduling therapy appointments, SMS reminders via Twilio, Stripe billing, separate database per clinic, patient portal.
A telehealth platform storing electronic health records, prescriptions, and patient intake charts under HIPAA.
Hospital integration gateway that syncs protected health information over HL7 and FHIR APIs across isolated hospital workspaces.
Emergency department clinical triage workstation capturing patient records and medical history for duty nurses.
Medical billing portal where patients view prescriptions, pay co-pays by credit card via Adyen, and update home addresses.
Illustrated reading app for children under 13 requiring verifiable parental consent and parent email before account creation.
Multiplayer puzzle game for 9-year-olds complying with COPPA with in-app purchases approved by parents.
Creative drawing studio for children aged 6 to 11 where kids' profiles stay private until parental approval completes.
K-12 school district gradebook storing student education records, transcripts, and IEP plans under FERPA with per-school isolation.
District attendance tracker syncing student transcripts and parent phone numbers via SendGrid email alerts.
Customer support desk for European Union customers enforcing GDPR data subject access and right to erasure across isolated customer workspaces.
HR onboarding platform holding EU residents' passport numbers, dates of birth, and employee salaries with GDPR compliance.
Public-facing marketing preference center for EEA users managing email addresses and right to be forgotten requests via Postmark.
Public storefront for California consumers honouring CCPA Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information and Sec-GPC signals, collecting shipping addresses and card payments via Stripe.
Privacy rights intake service automating CPRA and California Consumer Privacy Act deletion workflows across customer profiles and phone numbers.
Consumer loyalty directory serving California residents with Global Privacy Control opt-out and open self-serve registration.
PCI-DSS compliant credit card vault handling cardholder data and primary account numbers for multi-tenant merchant settlement.
Payment card processing proxy that tokenizes raw card numbers and dispatches outbound webhooks to merchant backends.
Retail back-office enforcing PCI DSS segmentation around cardholder data, settling invoices and handling chargebacks via Braintree.
General ledger close workbench enforcing Sarbanes-Oxley controls, ICFR sign-offs, and double-entry ledger reconciliation.
Operational incident console for EU financial entities subject to DORA compliance and ICT incident reporting via Slack webhooks.
B2B SaaS for enterprises collecting SOC 2 Type II evidence from GitHub API and Okta across isolated tenants.
Automated hiring scoring platform evaluating applicant resumes under the EU AI Act for multiple client companies, with each company having its own workspace.
High-risk AI automated credit scoring service verifying social security numbers and KYC verification documents via Plaid API.
Public marketplace holding buyer funds in escrow, issuing refunds, and releasing merchant payouts via Stripe Connect.
Multi-tenant analytics product with subscription billing, usage-based billing, and self-serve signup through Stripe Billing.
Internal finance tool that approves employee travel claims and schedules ACH transfers and reimbursements.
Payroll disbursement service storing employee salaries, tax IDs, and home addresses and executing SEPA transfers.
Consumer mobile app supporting wallet top-ups, cross-border remittances, and KYC verification with passport scans.
Supplier treasury tool settling funds via wire transfers and reconciling invoice payments in a double-entry ledger.
Public website collecting payments via Apple Pay and PayPal and emailing receipts to donor email addresses.
Delivery dispatch dashboard tracking driver GPS coordinates, customer phone numbers, and shipping addresses with carrier APIs.
Lobby check-in kiosk capturing driver's license scans, mobile numbers, and selfie verification photos for facility security.
Recruiting tracker storing applicant resumes, email addresses, and phone numbers across per-company workspaces.
Internal directory storing national ID numbers, birthdates, and biometric templates for warehouse badge provisioning.
Customer portal where shoppers manage billing addresses, customer profiles, and order notifications via Twilio SMS.
Document vault where each law firm has its own encrypted schema and strict tenant isolation prevents cross-tenant searches.
B2B SaaS for agencies offering per-client subdomains, separate workspaces per customer, and syncs with HubSpot and Salesforce API.
Bookkeeping platform where each accounting firm manages its own ledgers with per-tenant encryption and Stripe webhooks.
Multi-tenant knowledge base with tenant-scoped search indexes and SSO via SAML and Okta.
SaaS for merchants synchronizing warehouse stock through Shopify webhooks with per-merchant data partitioning.
Retention worker that permanently deletes archived rows, purges expired buckets, and drops old staging tables nightly.
Autonomous ops agent that executes shell commands, runs terraform apply, and terminates EC2 instances on idle clusters.
CI delivery bot using the GitHub API that pushes commits directly to release branches, merges pull requests automatically, and deploys to production.
Deployment runner that runs database migrations automatically and truncates tables during staging resets.
Cloud security daemon that modifies IAM policies, modifies firewall rules, and revokes production credentials on alert.
Decommissioning CLI that wipes storage volumes, destroys infrastructure stacks, and purges backups after lease end.
Compliance job for GDPR right to erasure that hard-deletes personal data across primary stores and purges records from caches.
Cluster cleanup controller executing kubectl delete on stale preview namespaces and bulk-deleting orphaned snapshots.
Public forum with open registration, anonymous browsing, and community topic voting.
Internet-facing link shortener providing a public REST API for unauthenticated callers and click counters.
Public status page accessible to anyone on the web displaying uptime charts and incident timelines.
Public directory of open-source plugins allowing anonymous visitors to search benchmarks and download metadata.
Public booking page with self-serve onboarding that syncs availability with Google Calendar and sends email via SendGrid.
Public web app accepting anonymous uploads of plain-text log snippets that expire after one hour.

Support operations connector that syncs with Zendesk and archives ticket attachments using AWS S3.

Public-facing K-12 learning platform for children under 13 storing student education records with parental consent, per-district isolation, and school subscription billing via Stripe.

Regulated financial treasury platform for EU financial entities complying with DORA, SOX controls, and PCI-DSS cardholder data rules, running SEPA transfers and permanently deleting expired staging exports via third-party APIs.

Public-facing multi-tenant deployment cloud with SOC 2 Type II controls, metered billing via Stripe, GitHub webhooks, email addresses for admins, and automated rollbacks that destroy infrastructure previews.
Local markdown linter that runs offline with no personal data, no credit cards, and no third-party APIs.
Synthetic benchmark generator for schema load testing that never stores protected health information, never collects PII, and does not call external APIs.
Offline mortgage amortization calculator that never accepts credit cards, does not process payments, and stores zero personal information.
Read-only SQL query explainer for local developers that never drops tables, never modifies production, and never executes shell commands.
Single-tenant internal runbook viewer with no multi-tenant workspaces, not public-facing, and without inbound webhooks.
Desktop endgame tablebase trainer not intended for children under 13, with no parental consent flows and zero personal data.
Internal billing reconciler that processes payouts via Stripe, but never stores personal data and never drops tables.
Static changelog formatter reading local git commits into release notes. Out of scope: Stripe billing, GDPR portals, patient records, and Slack webhooks.
Local CSV column profiler for laptops. Personal data is never stored and third-party APIs are prohibited.
A local terminal task manager storing plain todo items and due dates in a workspace JSON file.
Zero-dependency TypeScript library for parsing semantic version ranges and sorting release tags.
Minimal desktop focus timer tracking 25-minute work intervals and local session streaks.
Command-line batch tool that converts local PNG sprites into WebP thumbnails with deterministic hashes.
Small team sprint retrospective board collecting went-well and action cards during weekly engineering standups.
Kitchen notebook application scaling bread dough hydration percentages and fermentation schedules.
Streaming pipeline aggregating structured JSON latency histograms from local benchmark runs.
Offline spaced-repetition study deck scheduling vocabulary review intervals with the SM-2 algorithm.
